feature.modalBlur.name: Blur behind modals
feature.modalBlur.desc: Applies a backdrop blur to the dialog scrim so the editor behind it is softened while the dialog itself stays sharp.
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.name: Accent for the opened note
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.desc: Draws a flush accent bar on the left edge of the currently opened note in the document tree, with a customisable colour.
docTreeOpenedAccent.colorTip: Leave empty to follow the SiYuan theme primary; any CSS colour such as #rrggbb, rgb() or var(--b3-theme-primary) works
feature.mobileSidebarBlur.name: Blur behind mobile side panels
feature.mobileSidebarBlur.desc: Makes the mobile side panels translucent and blurred, so the document behind them is softened.
